findings.issue: «aroma» and «aromas» narrow H1314 (singular fragrant substance) and H5561 (plural) toward smell; the spice/balsam sense is uncertain.
«la» marks definite a prepositional noun that is absolute and has no article (Ncmsa), unlike the articulated nouns beside it.

notes: Order, number, both H8081 nouns, construct chains, and the three ל phrases match the tokens.
